name: DJSH International Holdings Limited
summary: DJSH International Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property development business in the People's Republic of China, Singapore, and internationally. The company develops and sells high-end residential, commercial office and complex, tourism real estate, and industrial base; constructs resettlement houses; and leases investment properties. It is also involved in the trading of building construction materials; logistics management; property management and ancillary services; and consultancy services.
